error_join_connect_failed: Could not connect to the game. The invitation may have expired or the host may be offline.
error_join_ticket_invalid: That invitation link or ticket is not valid.
error_join_ticket_required: Enter a ticket or invitation URL to join a game.
text_relay_servers_hint: Enter one relay server URL per line.
tutorial_after_safe_deducible: Nice! That cell was safe, and the numbers around it let you deduce another safe cell. The highlighted cell is provably safe. Feel free to press it next.
tutorial_after_safe_guess: Nice, that cell was safe. Pick another cell.
tutorial_after_void: That was a void! Voids are the cells you want to avoid and pressing each one ends your streak and deducts points. Click another cell to keep exploring.
tutorial_awaiting_first_click: The map is now interactive. Press any cell to reveal it and remember your goal is to avoid pressing "void" cells. Each safe cell with any void neighbors shows a number indicating how many of their neighbors are voids. As you explore the map, use that information to try to deduce which cells are safe and which are void. Good luck!
tutorial_intro: Welcome to Avoidant. On any map, drag with one finger or the left mouse button to pan. Drag with the right mouse button, hold Shift while dragging with the left mouse button, or drag with two fingers on a touchscreen to rotate around the map's center. Scroll to zoom toward the cursor, or pinch to zoom around the midpoint between your fingers. Rotation slows down as you zoom in. When you're comfortable with the controls, press Next to start exploring cells.
tutorial_won: Congratulations, you found every non-void cell! Your efficiency was {percent}%. Efficiency compares your score to the maximum possible score on this map: 100% means you only ever clicked safe cells.
text_invite_after_opening: Explore a cell before inviting players.
text_multiplayer_login: Log in to enable multiplayer modes.
error_invitation_invalid: Enter a valid invitation link or match ID.
text_account_multiplayer: Use your Kuncat account for multiplayer.
text_waiting_lobby: Waiting in lobby. Share the invitation link; the creator starts once everyone has joined.
error_match_version: Incompatible match version; update the game
error_player_name: Enter a player name of 1–32 characters.
error_name_server_update: This game server needs an update to support player names. Restart the local multiplayer server.
error_name_not_saved: The server did not save your name. Update the game server and try again.
help_play_mode: Choose solo play, a shared cooperative board, or competing territories.
help_player_name: Your name in the lobby, scores, and turn notices. You can change it in the lobby before play starts.
help_match_duration: Time allowed from match start. Maximum 24 hours. The server ends the match even if everyone disconnects.
help_tutorial_mode: Show guided tips for the controls and finding safe cells. Available with preset map sizes.
help_bordering: Claims must touch your existing territory. Players receive a starting cell when enabled; otherwise the board starts unexplored.
help_turn_based: Players act one at a time. When off, everyone can explore and claim cells simultaneously.
help_turn_timer: Automatically pass a player’s turn when time runs out. Turning this off does not disable the match duration limit.
help_turn_seconds: Seconds allowed for each turn. The server enforces the countdown, including while a player is disconnected.
help_flood_limit: Maximum additional cells revealed by a flood, excluding the clicked cell. ∞ allows unlimited reveals. Floods do not claim extra territory.
help_map: Choose the board’s surface. Flat maps are planar; the other shapes can be rotated to explore every side.
help_map_size: Choose the number of cells. Larger maps take longer to explore. Custom sizes are available in solo mode.
help_size: Set the total number of cells, from 32 to 5,000.
help_void_fraction: Fraction of cells that are voids. For example, 0.15 means about 15%. Higher values make safe cells harder to find.
help_spikiness: Adjust the unevenness of the terrain. Higher values produce sharper peaks.
help_seed: The same seed and map settings reproduce the same board. Use the dice button to choose a random seed.
help_turn_time: Time spent on turns, including timeouts and disconnected time (hours:minutes:seconds).
help_participation_time: Elapsed time from joining play until the match ends, including disconnected time (hours:minutes:seconds).
error_history: Could not load game history. Try again.
history_empty: Completed multiplayer games will appear here.
